parsed_json.up: Select distinct molecule chembl_id, compound name, and canonical SMILES for compounds linked to document CHEMBL3638969. Require canonical SMILES to be present. Join molecule_dictionary to compound_records on molregno, then to docs on doc_id, and inner join compound_structures on molregno. Filter by document chembl_id. Return chembl_id, compound_name, canonical_smiles. Sort by chembl_id, compound_name, canonical_smiles.
